The '''2024 Retro League Event 2''' was the second event of the [[2024 Retro League]] on [[GEMP]] (24 March – 8 May 2024), played in [[Premiere - Cloud City (Modified)]] format.<ref name="t84004" /> [[Paul Todd Feldman]] won.<ref name="t83974" />

== Format ==
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Cloud City (Modified)]]
* '''Site:''' [[GEMP]]
* '''Dates:''' 24 March – 8 May 2024
* '''Players:''' 71 (66 in the posted standings)
* '''Winner:''' [[Paul Todd Feldman]]

== Final standings ==
Final standings as posted by the tournament director (posted as images), in posted order.
